effect_description_eng: [On Play] If there're 6 or fewer total cards in both players' security stacks, you may play 1 yellow Tamer card from your hand without paying the cost.
inherited_effect_description_eng: [When Attacking] [Once Per Turn] If there're 6 or fewer total cards in both players' security stacks, 1 of your opponent's Digimon gets -2000 DP for the turn.
